product_summary: Real products/services per thelalit.com (home page + /about-us/): operation and management of 12 luxury hotels, palaces and resorts under 'The LaLiT' brand plus 2 mid-market 'The LaLiT Traveller' hotels — New Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore (Ashok), Chandigarh, Kolkata (Great Eastern), Jaipur, Udaipur (Laxmi Vilas Palace), Srinagar (Grand Palace), Goa (Golf & Spa Resort), Bekal (Resort & Spa), Khajuraho (Temple View), Mangar, plus a managed property in London. Revenue lines are room stays, dining, spa (Spiceology), MICE/meetings, weddings and 'Royal Experience' packages. The trade names in the input (Laxmi Vilas Palace Hotel, The LaLiT Jaipur/Mumbai/Bekal/Goa/Khajuraho/Mangar, The LaLiT Ashok Bangalore, The LaLiT Food Truck Company) are all hotel units / F&B outlets of the same group, not separate manufacturing lines. No product catalogue, no manufactured goods, no export product list found on the site.
comment: Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) does not match the company — it is a hotel operator/hospitality group (thelalit.com/about-us: 'engaged in the business of operating and managing hotels, palaces and resorts'). Declared HS 940131 (upholstered seats with wooden frames) is a furniture article and is not corroborated by anything on the company's own site: no furniture manufacture, no product catalogue, no trade offering. Status: заявлено, не подтверждено — the only public evidence is hospitality services, which have no HS code at all (services are classified under CPC, not HS). Per Rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds; the code is corrected/flagged: if the group genuinely exports hotel FF&E or furniture, the plausible code would be 9403.60 (wooden furniture) or 9401.61/9401.71 (other seats), but no customs line or catalogue supports any of these. Note the trader/agent angle: the input lists ~20 trade names and 'units of Bharat Hotels Ltd', which is typical of a multi-unit operator, not a manufacturer. No PAN, CIN, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope — null.
